name: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk.
summary: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk. specializes in delivering comprehensive telecommunications infrastructure solutions, operating primarily through its Telecommunication Tower Lease division and other associated services. The company is responsible for the operation and maintenance of vital components like macro and small cell sites, co-location facilities, and reseller partnerships. Additionally, it undertakes bespoke project implementations, encompassing fiber optic networks, comprehensive service delivery, tower construction, and mechanical and electrical systems. Its portfolio also includes managed services and advanced digital-based or Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructure offerings, such as remote tower management systems equipped with IoT-powered alarms for diverse locations. Founded in 1995, the firm was previously known as PT Dayamitra Malindo and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. It functions as a subsidiary of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk.
